title: Ocuiltec language
extract: Ocuiltec is a moribund language of Central Mexico closely related to Matlatzinca and Pirinda. Ocuiltec is also known as Tlahuica, Atzinca, and Atzingo Matlatzinca. "Ocuiltec" is commonly used in English, while Tlahuica is the preferred name in Spanish. The autonym Pjyɇkakjó or Pjiekakjoo is also preferred. Ocuiltec and Matlatzinca are both endangered with less than 2,000 speakers, while Prinida went extinct in 1936. There are revitalization efforts.
